composition-shift.alt: Graphs of f(x) = square root of x and f(g(x)) = square root of (x - 2): the composite is f moved 2 units right, so (4, 2) moves to (6, 2).

composition-machine.alt: Two rows of machines. Top row: x goes into machine g, g(x) comes out and goes into machine f, and f(g(x)) comes out. Bottom row with numbers: 2 goes into g, 0 comes out and goes into f, and 4 comes out.

composition-solve.alt: A parabola g and a line f on the same axes. The dashed line y = 2 meets the parabola at (-1, 2) and (3, 2). The line f passes through (0, -1) and (2, 3), so its outputs are -1 and 3 at x = 0 and x = 2.
